title.zh: 声音是波 · 看见自己的声音
title.en: Sound Is a Wave · Seeing Your Own Voice

desc.zh: 声音是空气一疏一密的传播：音调管波形的疏密，响度管振幅，音色管波形的形状；速度、波长、频率用 v = fλ 连在一起。本页不播放声音，只画波。
desc.en: Sound is a pattern of squeezing and loosening carried through air: frequency sets how close the pattern is, amplitude the loudness, and the wave’s shape the timbre; v = fλ ties speed, wavelength and frequency together. This page plays no sound, it only draws the waves.
